title: fix(plugin-charts): refuse a numeric axis no row can scale (objectui#7195)
body:
Fixes #7195
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

A cartesian tile whose numeric axis has rows, but not one row carrying a value that axis can build a scale from, drew an axis frame with zero marks and said nothing. It now renders the existing `data-chart-error` placeholder (the objectui#4683 channel, `ChartRefusal`, `role="status"`) with a **new code `no-numeric-value`** and a literal English sentence keyed on the whole dataset:

> This chart has no scale to draw on: none of the N rows has a numeric value for KEY.

(`its only row has no numeric value for KEY` when N is 1; several dead keys are joined with "or".) Ruling 5809002651, letter A. No "reject booleans" predicate and no authoring-time type check. No new i18n pack key, so `packages/i18n` is untouched.

Only `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`, the rewritten boolean pin in `AdvancedChartImpl.degeneratePosition.test.tsx`, a new `AdvancedChartImpl.noNumericValue.test.tsx` beside them, and `.changeset/7195-no-numeric-value-refusal.md`.

## Mechanism, measured before it was coded (the PM hypotheses, each checked)

- **H3 falsified: bare `Number.isFinite` on the raw value would refuse charts that draw.** Recharts builds a numeric domain through `makeDomain` / `makeNumber` in its axis selectors: a number (primitive or `Number` object), a string or a `Date` whose `Number()` is finite, or an array read by its first two elements when both pass that rule (range bars and areas; `[1, 2, 3]` draws). Booleans are rejected. Measured on this component under the package's fixed 480x320 harness: numeric strings (`'3'`) draw on every family, `''` draws at zero on line / area / scatter, and `Date` values draw on scatter. The predicate (`anchorsNumericAxis`) mirrors those readers and does not use `Number.isFinite` alone. An axis whose spec declares both a numeric `min` and `max` always has a scale, so it is never refused.
- **A stacked series is the exception, also measured.** A stacked bar or area gives its axis a scale through d3's stack (`Number(value)`) whatever its values, and any unstacked series on that axis is placed on it (an all-boolean series beside a stacked all-`null` one draws). Rather than model that per series, any series with a bar- or area-mode stack keeps the whole tile silent (seat ruling, round 4, `5824094683`). A line spreads no `stackId`, so its stack is inert and it follows the unstacked rule.
- **H2, per series or across all of them: across all of them.** An all-boolean series beside a numeric one on the same axis DRAWS (bar 3 rectangles; line and area 2 paths each). The numeric series gives the axis its scale and the booleans are placed on it, which is the same neighbour effect as scatter's mixed tile. Zero marks happen only when EVERY bound series is dead, so the series families refuse only then and name every series key.
- **H1, placement and precedence.** The series families' check (`hasNoNumericSeriesValue`) sits in the outer wrapper beside its siblings, in the order `missing-category-key`, then `no-plottable-series`, then `no-numeric-value`. It needs a category axis and a bound series before its sentence can be true, so both siblings are the more basic answer. Scatter's check sits in the scatter arm, after `scatter-multi-series` (a binding fault) and `no-plottable-points` (no row has a pair that can be placed), and before the `unplotted-points` footnote. Its pins keep their own codes (see the seam tests).
- **Code: a distinct one.** It is not `no-plottable-points` ("no row carries a PAIR") and not `no-plottable-series` ("nothing bound"): the binding exists, every row was read, and the axis still has no scale. A code shared with another arm is what the objectui#4695 review flagged as impossible for a machine to tell apart. Scatter and the series families share this ONE code because the diagnosis and the remedy are the same (bind a numeric column), and the family is already on the tile.
- **H4 held:** the sentence is a literal, as in objectui#4695. No console warning, matching the scatter answers: the sentence already names the key and the count.

## The narrowed accept-set (for the contract review)

**Now refused (each drew 0 marks before, measured on the base commit with the same probe):**

- scatter, x all-boolean / y all-boolean / both (the census cases); a single all-boolean row;
- scatter, a boolean mixed ONLY with rows that cannot be placed (`[true, null]`, `[true, 'n/a']`, `[true, NaN]`): before this change these drew 0 marks under an `unplotted-points` footnote reading "1 of 2 rows ... not drawn", which implied one point WAS drawn;
- bar / column / horizontal-bar / line / area / combo with no stacked bar or area series, when no row gives any bound series a value the axis can scale (every value boolean, `null` or an unparseable string); two series that are both all-boolean; a "stacked" line is judged the same way; an unstacked range with a boolean end.
- `min` or `max` alone, `logarithmic` alone and annotations do not build a scale, so those all-boolean tiles are still refused (0 marks on base). Any axis that declares a `stepSize` counts as having a scale: with one declared bound the renderer's tick builder (`ticksFor`) reads booleans as 0 / 1 and supplies the other end, so booleans draw. A `stepSize` alone is left silent too, erring toward silence (round 5).

**Still draws, unchanged, with no refusal and no note:**

- **the mixed control**: a boolean beside one real number (scatter 3 of 3; bar / line / area / combo draw) is the `:226` reverse control, kept green;
- numeric strings; `Number` objects; `Date` values; a boolean beside a numeric string; `''` (drawn at zero on line / area / scatter; on bar / horizontal-bar / combo it gives the silent all-zero picture it gave before, unchanged);
- range arrays read by their first two elements (`[1, 3]`, `[1, 2, 3]`) on bar / area / horizontal-bar / combo, stacked too;
- every chart with a stacked bar or area series, whatever its values, including an unstacked all-boolean or boolean-end-range sibling on the same axis. Stacked charts that draw nothing (a stacked all-`null` bar, a stacked area of unparseable strings) also stay silent, as before this PR;
- an axis whose spec declares both `min` and `max` (scatter `xAxis` / `yAxes[0]`; the series' `yAxes` entries): booleans are placed on the declared scale;
- an axis whose spec declares a `stepSize` together with a single `min` or `max` (series `yAxes` entries; scatter `xAxis` / `yAxes[0]`): booleans are placed on the tick-built scale;
- a dotted `dataKey` (for example `a.b`, which Recharts resolves through `get`) beside an all-boolean series;
- an all-boolean series beside a numeric series;
- a dual-axis tile with one live axis and one all-boolean axis: the live marks draw, and the dead axis stays silent. **Measured and declined**, because refusing the whole tile would blank marks that are on screen;
- a bound series key that is not a plain own property of any row, either a dotted path or a column no row carries (the objectui#8266 shape): left silent on purpose (see Acceptance notes).

## The `:226` pin

`a BOOLEAN coordinate is measured-and-DECLINED` is rewritten, not deleted, as `a BOOLEAN coordinate: the all-boolean tile is refused (objectui#7195), the mixed tile still draws`. The mixed half keeps its three assertions (3 marks, no note, no `no-plottable-points`) and adds "no `no-numeric-value`". The all-boolean half now asserts 0 marks, no plot, no `no-plottable-points`, and the `no-numeric-value` refusal with the text "none of the 2 rows has a numeric value for xm". The two `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` comments that described the boolean case as deliberately left silent now point to the new refusal.

## Evidence

**Current head `1e13495e2`** (patch round 5 after the round-5 at-tier review `5824416651` FAILED on `0e5bb6e8b`; full numbers in the round-5 report `5824848065`):

- Package: **801 tests** green. Full package lint (`eslint .`): exit 0, **0 errors**. Consumers: **126 files / 2015 tests**. Type-check exit 0.
- Ablation: removing the `stepSize` clause from `declaresScale` turns exactly the 22 `stepSize` pins red and no other. Restore proven.
- Probe, base `cd7b728b9` vs head, **640 tiles** (a 255-tile condensed rounds 0–4 population, a 300-tile matrix of `stepSize` with and without a bound, and 85 review-reconstruction tiles): drew-on-base 341, drawn tiles changed **0**, new refusals over base marks **0**.

Patch round 4, at `0e5bb6e8b`:

- Package: **785 tests** green. Full package lint (`eslint .`): exit 0, **0 errors**. Consumers: **126 files / 2015 tests** (the round-4 review re-derived the same figure). Type-check exit 0.
- Ablation: removing the stacked-tile clause turns exactly the 38 stacked pins red and no unstacked pin. Restore proven.
- Widened before/after probe, base `cd7b728b9` vs head, **782 tiles**, including **302 mixed stacked + unstacked tiles on one axis** and the 28 round-4 review tiles: drew-on-base 432, drawn tiles changed **0**, new refusals over base marks **0**.

Patch round 3, at `604f051c7`:

- Package: **783 tests** green. Full package lint (`eslint .`): exit 0, **0 errors**. Consumers: **126 files / 2015 tests** (vitest JSON reporter; the per-path breakdown and the exact command are in the report). Type-check exit 0.
- Two-leg ablation: bar-family stacked rule 26 red, exactly its pins; line-family branch 2 red, exactly its pins. Restore proven.
- Widened before/after probe, base `cd7b728b9` vs head, **694 tiles** (426 stacked shapes across six families, plus the round-2 population): drew-on-base 322, drawn tiles changed **0**, new refusals over base marks **0**.

Patch round 2, at `89c43b447`:

- Package: **755 tests** green. Full package lint (`eslint .`): exit 0, **0 errors**. Consumers: 126 files / 2015 tests. Type-check exit 0.
- Four-leg ablation: each leg turns exactly its own pins red (length check 3, `Number` objects 2, stacked arrays 1, declared domain 9). Restore proven.
- Widened before/after probe, base `cd7b728b9` vs head, **394 tiles** (declared domains full / min-only / max-only / logarithmic / stepSize, annotations, dual-axis binding, length-1 and length-3 arrays, stacked ranges, `Number` objects): drew-on-base 134, drawn tiles changed **0**, new `no-numeric-value` 196, new refusals over base marks **0**.

Patch round 1, at `18f03f4d6`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/`: **Test Files 68 passed (68), Tests 704 passed (704)**. Consumers: **126 files / 2015 tests** passed. Type-check exit 0. The same gate set exits 0.
- Two-leg ablation: removing the array clause turns exactly the two range pins red (2 failed / 100 passed of 102). Removing the resolved-key gate turns exactly the two dotted-key pins and the two absent-key silence pins red (4 failed / 98 passed of 102). Restore proven.
- Before/after probe, base `cd7b728b9` vs head, **161 tiles**: drew-on-base 83, drawn tiles changed 0, new `no-numeric-value` 49, new refusals over base marks 0.

History, at the first head `774582568`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` from the repo root: **Test Files 68 passed (68), Tests 698 passed (698)**.
- Consumers that render charts outside the package (all of `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/`, the app-shell `DatasetPreview` and `widget-dom-leak-sweep` files, the `plugin-report` chart-locale file, `examples/schema-catalog` gallery render): **Test Files 126 passed (126), Tests 2015 passed (2015)**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` after building the `@object-ui/plugin-charts^...` closure: exit 0. The `tsconfig.test.json` `--listFiles` includes both touched test files (2 hits).
- **Ablation**, committed first and restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: an early `return true` injected into `anchorsNumericAxis` (marker `grep -c` 1 after the mutation, 0 after the restore). The two files went **43 failed / 93 passed of 136**. That is exactly the 43 refusal assertions (scatter 6, series families 36, the rewritten `:226` pin 1), and every drawing and seam test stayed green. Restore proven by `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob `02440cbc57dc` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. No build step was involved: the tests import `./AdvancedChartImpl` from source.
- Gates, derived from `package.json` and `.github/workflows/` for the touched paths, each with exit 0: `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`.
- Lint, narrowed and declared: `eslint --format json` over the three touched files from the package directory (the same `eslint .` config the package's `lint` script uses): 3 files, **0 errors**, 64 warnings (`no-explicit-any` in the test harness style, plus existing ones in the source file). The config has no type-aware parser options, so the diff cannot change the verdict for any file it did not touch. The full `pnpm lint` run belongs to CI.
- `check-changeset-claims` pointed at `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md` because it names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`. I read that paragraph: `stack` still becomes `stackId` and `yAxis` still binds the secondary axis, so it is still true.

## Acceptance notes

- **An absent series key is not covered.** A bar whose series names `value` over rows that carry `count` draws 0 marks, and the ruling's predicate literally holds for it. But the render pins in `ObjectChart.countSeriesKeyRender-8266.test.tsx` and `ObjectChart.categoryAxisKeyRender-8269.test.tsx` keep that shape silent. Their header asks for that to be "re-decided rather than a silent behaviour change nobody notices", and both files are outside this card's file surface. A first draft that covered the shape turned exactly those two pins red, so the refusal fires only when every bound series key is a plain own property of some row. A dotted path (Recharts resolves it through `get`) or a column no row carries keeps the tile silent: an unresolved key cannot be known not to draw. The absent-key shape is filed as its own card, objectui#10396.
- **A `stack` on a line series has no effect in this renderer** (the line arms spread no `stackId`), and the predicate reads the line family the same way, so a "stacked" all-boolean or all-unparseable line is refused (0 marks on base).
- **Dual axis, one dead axis:** measured and declined, as described above.
- `bar` with every value `''` draws 0 rectangles, because recharts reads `''` as zero and the domain is `[0, 0]`. That is the same picture as an all-zero bar, which is finite data and not this defect. It is not refused.

Card relations are declared here only; the commit carries no card trailer.
